notes: SWP Mem III p. 220 Rujm el Mogheifir (linked in Stage 1b; also called Tell el Kursi = Nigro 78/79 at 4-20 m) treated as the unit; its barrel-vaulted cisterns have no direction (position none). SWP Mem III p. 24 Birket Jiljulieh is not the unit but is named in S2531's other names (1562 m), so its pool and the Arab graveyard north of it are given S2531's point. SWP Mem III p. 202 Kanat Musa (aqueduct system; found because it names Rujm el Mogheifir) is not this unit; the cisterns it mentions (Mefjir, Bir Heider, east of Birket Musa) are not located within 2 km by the packet; not coded. Unit's own row has no pool, pit or grave ('large basalt vessels' are not pools). Nigro features dated only by period heading coded U. N74 'plastered basin' has no size: pool_def unclear.
